The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of the delivered solution:

## `/workspace/submission/main.py` (single self-contained module, 24 KB)

**Staged validation, exactly in the specified order:**
1. Line length > 1,048,576 bytes → `E_LIMIT`
2. Strict UTF-8 decode → `E_JSON`
3. String/escape-aware bracket pre-scan (unmatched delimiter kinds, depth floored at zero, > 64 → `E_LIMIT`, applied even to malformed text)
4. `json.loads` with an `object_pairs_hook` rejecting duplicate keys and `parse_constant` rejecting `NaN`/`Infinity`/`-Infinity` → `E_JSON`
5. Scalar scan of every string and object key (no unpaired surrogates) → `E_SCHEMA`
6. Full schema check (exact key sets, `match/startswith/endswith/contains` atom paths over the declared alphabet, expression forms, rule shapes, query tokens) → `E_SCHEMA`; declared size limits (24 services × 64 scalars, 32 rules, 256 nodes, 32 args, 16-token atom paths, 10 distinct atoms, 256 queries / 4096 / 16384 tokens) evaluated only after the schema passes → `E_LIMIT`

**Exact atomic-monitor complexity:** one monitor per distinct `(op, path)` atom (including atoms in semantically unreachable branches), synchronous product BFS with the 20,000-tuple cap → `E_COMPLEXITY`. Two provably count-preserving reductions are used: constant-coordinate monitors are dropped (their coordinate is fixed) and tokens acting identically on every monitor are explored once.

**Compilation:** rule semantics are evaluated bit-parallel over all 2^K atom-truth masks (`L = ⋃allow \ ⋃drop`); distances come from a backward BFS (which also identifies non-viable states); all non-viable states collapse into one dead state; Hopcroft refinement (initial partition by distance — a language invariant) yields the minimal DFA; canonical BFS numbering in declared alphabet order; columns expanded back to the full alphabet; queries simulated from state 0.

**Validation performed:** byte-identical public examples; 97 hand-written error/precedence/limit cases; ~6000 randomized requests cross-checked against an independent spec-literal reference plus language/minimality/canonical-numbering/distance oracles; 7200 cap-semantics comparisons at nine different caps; DFAs up to 15,872 states verified; worst-case 8-line payloads run in ≈7 s with ~100 MB RSS and ~17 MB output.
